title: Restore service startup after versioned migration wiring defect
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: На бою теперь вообще не стартует, сразу вылетает. Локально запустил - там вот такая картина

scope.goal: Correct the confirmed versioned-migration dependency-injection startup defect so the ordinary PolyCopyTrader service resolves the non-empty default migration catalog, reaches schema initialization, and does not report a fatal startup failure as a successful process exit.
inScope: Ensure production dependency-injection construction of PostgresSchemaInitializer uses PostgresSchemaMigrationCatalog.CreateDefault() and cannot select the test-only custom-catalog constructor with an empty unregistered IEnumerable<PostgresSchemaMigration>.

Add a focused regression test that resolves IStorageSchemaInitializer through the same implementation-type DI registration shape used by the service and proves construction succeeds without registering individual PostgresSchemaMigration services.
Make the existing top-level fatal startup exception path set a nonzero process exit code after logging the exception.
Run focused tests, a complete solution build, an isolated local fatal-start process smoke test, requirement validation, and independent semantic review.
Preserve all pre-existing unrelated working-tree changes outside this contract's commits.
outOfScope: Changing the immutable migration baseline, migration identifiers, checksums, SQL, schema eligibility predicates, schema_migration_history contents, or pending-only migration behavior.
Connecting a local service run to production, changing production PostgreSQL, deploying or starting/stopping/restarting the production service, or changing server files or configuration.
Changing strategies, signals, bets, orders, Paper/Live execution, stakes, PnL, Dashboard behavior, runtime workers, or external API behavior.
Adding a migration framework, redesigning dependency injection generally, refactoring unrelated startup code, or absorbing the unrelated PostgresSchema.cs and StorageTests.cs working-tree edits.
scope.periodOrFilter: Ordinary PolyCopyTrader.Service startup for the current versioned-migration implementation only; no production data period applies.
scope.firstVerification: Resolve IStorageSchemaInitializer from an isolated ServiceCollection using the current production implementation-type registration and a dummy non-production PostgresConnectionFactory, without calling InitializeAsync or opening any database connection.

requirements.text: Ordinary service dependency injection must construct PostgresSchemaInitializer with the non-empty default migration catalog.
acceptanceCriteria: The custom-catalog constructor remains available to the existing friend test assembly but is not a public constructor candidate for the production DI container.
The public production constructor continues to call PostgresSchemaMigrationCatalog.CreateDefault().
Resolving IStorageSchemaInitializer from a ServiceCollection with the production implementation-type registration succeeds when no PostgresSchemaMigration service is registered.
The DI regression test performs no database connection, schema operation, or external call.

verification.command: Run the focused PostgresSchemaMigrationTests under the marked D:\CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: The new production-DI construction regression passes together with the existing migration catalog and isolated PostgreSQL migration tests.

requirements.text: A fatal exception during ordinary service startup must result in a nonzero process exit code.
requirements.sourceQuote: Локально запустил - там вот такая картина
acceptanceCriteria: The existing top-level catch continues to write the Fatal Serilog event and additionally sets Environment.ExitCode to 1.
A bounded local process smoke test against an intentionally unreachable loopback PostgreSQL endpoint exits with code 1 and does not contact production.
Successful ordinary host shutdown semantics are otherwise unchanged.

verification.command: Launch the freshly built service executable from a marked D:\CodexTemp output with POLYCOPYTRADER_POSTGRES_CONNECTION overridden to an unreachable 127.0.0.1 endpoint and a bounded connection timeout; capture only its exit code and sanitized startup log.
verification.expected: The process exits within the bound with code 1 after a fatal startup log and makes no production connection.

requirements.text: The repair must remain limited to the confirmed startup wiring and fatal-exit defects and must not alter migration, database, or trading behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: No migration SQL, baseline identifier/checksum, production eligibility predicate, migration execution order, or history behavior changes.
No production database, service, deployment, configuration, strategy, signal, bet, order, Paper/Live, PnL, Dashboard, or API state changes during implementation or verification.
The complete solution builds with zero errors and focused tests pass.
Pre-existing unrelated working-tree changes remain outside this contract's commits and are byte-for-diff preserved.
Independent review compares both verbatim user requests, the approved contract, the actual diff, and verification evidence and returns PASS with no open findings.

verification.command: Build PolyCopyTrader.sln with all disposable outputs under the marked D:\CodexTemp run.
verification.expected: The complete solution builds with zero errors.

verification.command: Inspect the exact governed diff, compare hashes of unrelated dirty files, run requirement validation, and obtain independent semantic review.
verification.expected: Only approved paths and context/contract records changed; unrelated files are preserved; validators pass; reviewer returns PASS with no findings.
